bank: # --- sound driver internals (bank 7E; banks 7C/7D hold the same code at $4000-$52D8: SoundUpdate maps the song's bank before the channel updates

name: SoundSetMuteMask
comment: export $08 (unused): a -> wSoundMuteMask; those channels are cleared from NR51 by SoundUpdatePanning

name: SoundIsMusicPlaying
comment: export $0A (unused): a = 0 when wMusicRequest is $80 (no song) else 1

name: SoundIsSFXPlaying
comment: export $0C (unused): a = 0 when wSFXRequest is $80 else 1

name: SoundTogglePause
comment: export $0E (unused): flips wSoundPaused; while set SoundUpdate only silences the music channels

name: SoundSetMasterVolume
comment: export $10 (unused): a & 7 to both NR50 nibbles via wMasterVolume

name: SoundSilenceMusicChannels
comment: clears wChannelActive and silences each channel not held by an effect (wSFXChannelMask)

name: SoundNop
comment: empty routine called first by SoundUpdate

name: MusicUpdateCh1
comment: square 1: gate timer -> note off; note timer -> next script command then note on; vibrato

name: MusicUpdateCh3
comment: wave channel: gate timer -> volume from wChParamE9; note timer -> next command; note on

name: MusicUpdateCh4
comment: noise channel: note timer -> next command; else steps the noise pattern (MusicCh4NoiseStep)

name: MusicRunScript
comment: bc = channel: reads script bytes from hl; >= $D0 command via MusicCommandTable; else a note

name: MusicCommandTable
comment: word per command $D0-$FF (see REVERSE.md Sound: music script)

name: MusicPlayNote
comment: note byte: low nibble+1 x wChLengthUnit = duration; high nibble = pitch (0 rest); gate from wChGate; frequency from octave table + transpose + detune

name: MusicCmdTie
comment: $D9: wChNoteState = $80 so the next note does not retrigger

name: MusicCmdPanning
comment: $DC nn: sets this channel's bits of wPanning from nn

name: MusicCmdRepeatStart
comment: $DF nn: pushes (return address and count nn) on the channel stack

name: MusicCmdRepeatEnd
comment: $E0: decrements the count and jumps back until it is 0 then pops

name: MusicCmdCall
comment: $E2 word: pushes the return address on the channel stack and jumps

name: MusicCmdDetune
comment: $E4 nn: wChDetune (signed added to the frequency)

name: MusicCmdWave
comment: $E7 nn: wWaveIndex = nn and reload the wave RAM at the next note

name: MusicCmdGate
comment: $E8 nn: wChGate (note sounds duration x nn / 8 frames; 8 = full)

name: MusicCmdParamE9
comment: $E9 nn: wChParamE9 (wave channel volume after the gate)

name: MusicCmdRelease
comment: $EE nn: wChRelease (envelope used at note off)

name: MusicCmdEnd
comment: $DA $DB $EF-$FF: channel off (wChannelActive = 0) and stops the script

name: MusicNextCommand
comment: pops the script pointer and continues MusicRunScript

name: MusicCh1NoteOn
comment: writes NR10-NR14 from wChDuty / wChFreq; retriggers with wChEnvelope unless tied

name: MusicCh1NoteOff
comment: end of the gate: NR12 from the release envelope (wChRelease) and retrigger

name: MusicCh3NoteOn
comment: wave channel: reloads the wave (LoadWavePattern) when asked; NR30-NR34

name: LoadWavePattern
comment: copies the 16-byte wave wWaveIndex (pointer table 7E:4CDD) to $FF30

name: MusicCh4NoteOn
comment: noise: writes the 4 bytes wNoiseRegs to NR41-NR44

name: MusicCh4NoiseStep
comment: next byte of the noise pattern (wNoisePtr) to NR43 each frame; $FF ends it

name: SoundUpdatePanning
comment: NR50 = wMasterVolume; NR51 = wPanning merged with the effect channels and wSoundMuteMask

name: MusicVibratoFreq
comment: de = channel frequency plus the vibrato offset (table 7E:50C9) after wChVibratoDelay frames

name: MusicApplyVibrato
comment: a = channel: writes the vibrato frequency to the channel registers

name: MusicAddDetune
comment: de += signed wChDetune of channel bc

name: SoundSilenceAll
comment: silences every channel not held by an effect (used while paused)

name: SoundSaveAndStop
comment: export $12 (unused): saves the music state (SoundSaveState) and silences it

name: SoundRestoreAndResume
comment: export $14 (unused): silences and restores the saved music state

name: SoundSaveState
comment: copies the music driver state $C4C0-$C56D to $C59A-$C629

name: SoundRestoreState
comment: copies the saved state back (reverse of SoundSaveState)

name: SoundCopyBytes
comment: copies a bytes from hl to de

name: MusicOctaveTable
comment: first note index of each octave in MusicFreqTable

name: MusicFreqTable
comment: word per semitone: GB frequency register values

name: WavePatternTable
comment: word per wave: pointer to 16 bytes of wave RAM

name: NoiseInstrumentTable
comment: word per noise octave and pitch: pointer to panning + NR41 NR42 NR43 NR44 bytes then an NR43 pattern ending $FF

name: VibratoTable
comment: word per vibrato type: signed offsets; $80 = loop / $80 nn = switch type

name: wPanning
comment: NR51 shadow for the music; set by music command $DC

name: wChDuty
comment: 4 bytes: duty bits per channel (music command $E5)

name: wWaveIndex
comment: wave pattern for the wave channel (music command $E7)

name: wWaveReload
comment: 1 = copy the wave pattern at the next wave note

name: wSFXChannelMask
comment: bits 0-3: channels in use by a sound effect (music does not write them)

name: wChScriptPtr
comment: 4 words: music script pointer per channel

name: wChNotePitch
comment: 4 bytes: high nibble of the last note (0 = rest)

name: wChNoteTimer
comment: 4 bytes: frames until the next script command

name: wChGate
comment: 4 bytes: share of the note that sounds in eighths (music command $E8)

name: wChParamE9
comment: 4 bytes (music command $E9; wave channel volume after the gate)

name: wChLengthUnit
comment: 4 bytes: frames per note length step (music command $D0)

name: wChStackPtr
comment: 4 words: per-channel repeat/call stack pointer (stacks at $C53E 12 bytes each)

name: wSoundSaveArea
comment: copy of the driver state made by SoundSaveState
